startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: List of website URLs to scrape for contact information and emails. Can be URLs or objects with 'url', 'id', 'business_name'.

maxDepth.title: Max Depth
maxDepth.description: How many contact/about subpages to inspect if no email is found on the homepage.

checkSocials.title: Check Social Profiles
checkSocials.description: If true, attempts to inspect linked Facebook or social pages for listed contact emails when none are found on the site.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Recommended for bypassing Cloudflare / anti-bot checks.
